testcase.name: the circle and fill layers are the sighting dot and the offline region in their own roles
every symbol layer in the registry is a bitmap marker in the role's colour
each find and photo marker carries its record id
each planned trip's feature carries the trip's own id
a tapped waypoint's id is the one its builder wrote
every line layer in the registry is a line the map builds, on the same source, in the role's colour
a tapped sighting's id is its observationId in decimal
the search centre and the breadcrumb carry fixed ids
each offline region circle carries its region id
a sighting's feature keeps its observationId and gains no second id
each waypoint's feature carries the waypoint's own id
a tapped feature with no id reads as a hit with no id, not a made-up one
each kept track's line carries its track id, and a dropped short track shifts no other id
